scope.description: Independent source-first and evidence review of the local Replicate T2V/I2V adapter and guarded fixture Checkout/portal commands after final exact-identity and strict-DTO corrections.

candidate.captureMethod: node scripts/candidate-digests.mjs stdout; aggregate acceptance recapture remains required after any register/status update

requirements: Pinned Replicate T2V and I2V versions and retained catalog snapshots
Safe 720p/81-frame/16-fps mapping; I2V uses an authorized image and omits unsupported aspect_ratio
Injected transport makes exactly one create call with retry=false
Accepted, definite rejection and unknown outcomes normalize without raw provider leakage
Status/result require the exact persisted provider ID and reject absent or mismatched identities
Live rows remain disabled and no Replicate network or paid call is made
5.2.resolvedFinding: A RED regression showed status/result bodies without the persisted provider ID were accepted; shared normalization now requires a present exact ID for Replicate and fal.
limits: The adapter does not persist generation attempts, prediction IDs, callbacks, leases or durable media; those remain downstream domain/runtime tasks.
No live Replicate account, credential, paid request, callback authentication or durable output is claimed.

requirements: Current owner and active workspace are checked under the existing workspace lock
Server-owned catalog/customer/price/return values and monthly-or-pack terms are enforced
Checkout attempts and durable command identity are committed before fixture provider invocation
Recurring open/unknown slots remain exclusive; permanent packs remain available
Billing hold denies Checkout while allowing owner Portal recovery
Unknown Checkout results retry the same persisted attempt/provider identity
Same-origin authenticated routes reject extra browser-controlled DTO fields
limits: The service probe uses a deterministic local fixture and does not create Stripe objects, call Stripe, receive webhooks or issue credits.

The retained PostgreSQL probe passed on the isolated loopback cluster; an independent rerun against the current 5432 role could not create a disposable database because that role lacks CREATEDB. This environment limitation does not contradict the retained PASS evidence.
Portal pending-command crash recovery is not exercised as an external-provider test; authenticated Stripe portal behavior remains downstream work.

independentCommands.command: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm verify:db-boundary
corepack pnpm verify:openspec && corepack pnpm verify:config

independentCommands.reason: Current 5432 database role lacks permission to create a disposable database; retained isolated-cluster evidence passed all nine cases and removed its database.

aggregateRecaptureReason: The current source/validator digests changed after the prior acceptance candidate; rerun aggregate verification and update current M4/M5 development records before using this review as current-candidate evidence.
conclusion: PASS is limited to the bounded local implementation contracts and retained disposable PostgreSQL evidence for tasks 5.2 and 6.2. It does not close M4/M5, current M3 equivalence, or any external-provider/payment gate.
